notes.title: MW5 Clans + GB:FS Minor Update
notes.notes:
Mechwarior 5 Clans - Minor Update fixes and improvements

New Game +

Award merits to players when they complete missions in NG+. Helps for getting all the goodies you may have missed out on in run 1.

Missions

Iron wall - Fixed mission blocker that occurs when Elementals destroy the generators before the player enters the room with them in it.

Elementals

Elementals can now follow dynamic jump jet paths created by the player

Radial Menu

Escape key should close Radial Menu without opening the Pause Screen

Mission UI

Added an incomplete state for difficulty icons so they read better when selected.

Other MechWarrior Games feature now in Main Menu

Players can get quick access to information about our other games in the MechWarrior series from Piranha Games (Mercs and MWO).

 

MechWarrior 5 Clans Editor Update

Many big fixes to support MechWarrior5: Clans Mod Editor have been made

Mod Editor itself will be release upon approval by Epic ETA is in the next 2 weeks.

notes.notes: Fixed a crash issue related to FSR and global illumination.

notes.title: GHOST BEAR: FLASH STORM – HOTFIX INTEL
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622047/7ec1e0dcb9bf7bf7caf730725052c2bcb7d19bc8.jpg

Greetings Warriors,

We’ve been watching your gameplay, reading your feedback, and digging into your reported issues. Thanks for taking the time to share — we’re listening and acting fast.

A few major bugs have stood out, so we’re rolling out a two-stage hotfix to address them.

HOTFIX 1 – ETA: Tonight / Early Tomorrow (May 9)

FIXED – FSR Crash
We’ve resolved a crash issue related to FSR and global illumination. The fix has been tested and confirmed, and we're planning to deploy the patch for Steam players tonight.
Until then a temporary workaround is available in your graphics options by setting Global illumination to medium

HOTFIX 2 – ETA: Mid Next Week (May 14)

IMPROVEMENT – Elementals Getting Stuck
We’ve identified and addressed an issue where Elementals could become unresponsive or stuck during missions.

Coming Soon: 
We’re also collecting additional improvements for the MW5: Clans and Ghost Bear, and those will be rolling in a Update Patch

 We are investigating adding Elemental controls to the Battlegrid
 Investigating adding a Feature to allow Host to pause the game for all players 
 Major Expansion to the Digital Collectors Art Book Content 
 More details on that patch are coming soon — stay tuned.


Thanks again for your continued support and feedback. We’ll keep you updated as fixes roll out!
— The MechWarrior 5 Clans Team

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622047/21429fee4c2f930af11ab57535fa4e48974eebfe.jpg
Greetings, Warriors!
We've prepared a new patch to address some issues in MechWarrior 5: Clans. This update focuses on fixing crashes and improving overall game reliability.
Patch Deployment: Monday at 2 PM Pacific 

Patch Notes:

 Fixed a GPU hang crash.
 Resolved a crash when clicking on star names in the Battlegrid.
 Fixed an issue where clients in co-op would not see load screens or spinners if the host disconnected or crashed.
 Addressed a fatal error crash that could occur immediately upon launch.
 Fixed a Battlegrid-related crash in Horde Mode.


Thank you for your continued support. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Hotfix #2 Preview
notes.notes:
Greetings MechWarriors,

First off we want to say a huge thankyou to all of our players. We are here and we are listening. 

We hope Hotfix 1 addressed a lot of the performance issues that players reported.
We are working on Hotfix 2 right now and we're almost done, our ETA is early next week.  Hotfix 2 continues with performance and coop fixes along with many others – check them all out in detail below. 
Thank you for your support!

-The MechWarrior 5: Clans Team

HOTFIX #2 Details

Fixed Issues:
Co-Op
o	Fixed a bug where clients would sometimes be stuck in the fade to black state after using a repair bay
o	Adjusted the position of the Union takeoff in ‘Pirate’s Bay'
o	Fixed an issue for clients in ‘A World on Fire’ where an enemy 'Mech would disappear briefly during a sequence
o	Fixed a replication issue with the gate generators on ‘Kishi Kaisei’
o	Fixed a replication bug where clients could not walk through certain wall assets destroyed by other clients in ‘A World on Fire’
o	Fixed a bug where the mission area would close off before all players have left in ‘Hold the Line’
o	Fixed a bug where the small gate in ‘Jaguar’s Down' would not open for clients
o	Fixed a client bug where they could not see Chassis Milestones
o	Fixed a Co-Op bug where users can join mid-mission without a HUD
o	Fixed an occurrence where clients can start a mission with the Scan Mode prompt flashing
o	Fixed a rare instance where an enemy would not appear in ‘Smuggler's Den'
Campaign Missions
o	Fixed a salvage crate in ‘Combat Patrol’ that was giving the incorrect rewards
o	Fixed an issue on ‘The Golden Forge’ where some mechs were temporarily indestructible 
o	Fixed the Union takeoff sequence in ‘Inspection Duty’
o	Fixed a bug where certain enemy ‘Mechs would not target you in 'A World on Fire’
o	Adjusted objectives at the start of ‘Kishi Kaisei’ so they can no longer be missed
o	Changed all ally ‘Mechs in 'Traffickers’ to use the Beta Galaxy camo pattern
o	Reduced the chances saKhan Weaver would get caught on terrain in ‘Pirate’s Bay'
o	The host is now the only one able to make the choice in ‘Reckoning’
o	Fixed the ‘Mech cockpit during the intro of 'A World on Fire’
o	Reduced the chances of critical explosion on the boss in ‘Kishi Kaisei’
o	Fixed Jayden’s helmet in his communication pips in the first mission 
o	Added the proper pilot names when targeting allies in ‘Kishi Kaisei’
Art
o	Improved the texture of the large trees on Huntress
o	Adjusted the flamer VFX orientation so the origin point appears correct
Audio
o	Fixed an audio issue where sound was temporarily ducked at the start of the first mission
o	Fixed an instance where Naomi would repeat the same line twice in a row in ‘No Stone Unturned’
Gameplay
o	Increased the SRM ammo values up to 150 rounds per ton
o	Buffed the Corsair on ‘No Stone Unturned’
o	Added a confirmation prompt when selecting Restart Mission on the pause menu
o	Disabled the ability to use scan while spectating 
o	Removed the ability to order commands when your 'Mech is shut down
o	Fixed a bug where players can sometimes lose repair bay capabilities 
o	Adjusted the scannable object radiuses to be more accurate 
o	Fixed a bug where the mission boundary lines would disappear when using night vision
o	Fixed a bug where you could fire weapon groups 2-6 while the radial menu is open
UI
o	Adjusted the technician panel on the repair screen on ultrawide aspect ratios
o	Updated the pilot skill upgrade menu to show available currency
o	Updated the active probe element on the HUD
o	Mechlab how properly greys out options when the user has no 'Mechs
o	Adjusted the transitions when backing out of missions in Mission Central
o	Reduced the flickering of the 'Mech in the Mechlab and Marketplace while navigating menus and performing actions
o	Adjusted the safe zone width to work better with triple monitors
o	Fixed the scroll prompt on the Artbook menu
Settings
o	Fixed a joystick control bug where invert Y-Axis would instead invert X-Axis after applying
o	Fixed instances where the spacebar key to apply changes would not function
o	Fixed a bug where the Mirror Paper Doll option would not apply until you restarted a mission
Localization
o	Major update across the board for Japanese language 
o	Fixed the overlapping/out of bounds text on several screens in Russian
o	Fixed the translation for ‘general’ in the Marketplace and Mech Bay in Japanese
o	Fixed the spacing on some settings menu prompts in German

We’re currently working on these fixes and expect them to be in Hotfix 2 although not confirmed yet:
•	More performance improvements
•	Add an option in Co-Op to allow clients to select the pilot they want to play and swap pilots
•	Fixed a Co-Op bug where users were stuck as other pilots when starting a new campaign after playing a Co-Op session
•	Fixed a Co-Op issue where clients would view stuttering with other players
•	Fixed a bug where key bindings would be changed without applying them
•	Fixes for missing audio in pause menu
•	Fixes for audio on burst fire weapons
•	Fix for weapon group audio being too quiet
•	Fix for DLSS option permanently greying itself out under rare conditions

We heard you didn’t like this – so we reverted it
•	Users should not be able to unbind Primary KBM input actions. (But you will have the unbound issue if you do this)

Other issues:
•	We heard some players are experiencing audio issues in cinematics – we’re looking into this and will fix as soon as we can.
•	We heard that lower end AMD cards are having driver issues – so we’re reaching out to AMD to try and get a solution as quickly as possible.

Until Hotfix 2 drops here are some workarounds for 2 controller issues:

For controls changes not saving after game restart:
After changing the controls to your preference, close the game.
Open File Explorer
Click the address bar at the top
Copy-paste the following line and hit Enter:
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\Windows\
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\WinGDK\ (for Game Pass and Microsoft Store)
Right-click on the GameUserSettings.ini file and select Properties
Under the General tab check Read-only and click OK.

For not being able to invert Joystick on Y axis:
Open File Explorer
Click the address bar at the top
Copy-paste the following line and hit Enter:
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\Windows\
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\WinGDK\ (for Game Pass and Microsoft Store)
Use Notepad to open GameUserSetting.ini
Edit the following line to say True:
InvertJoystickYAxis=True

-MechWarrior 5: Clans Team

CO-OP
Fixed a Co-op issue where clients could not see the Gazelle in 'Inspection Duty'
Fixed an issue for clients where the Leopard and Union Dropships would not animate in ‘Inspection Duty’

Fixed a bug where night vision carried over to the following mission
Adjusted AI so they can better execute repair bay orders
Fixed a bug where unlocked melee weapons could not be equipped to hand actuators

Improved Mechbay warning and error messages

UI

Fixed a bug where the ESC key would no longer function
Fixed a bug where you are able to interact with elements under the Private Policy/EULA pop-ups

Fixed controller Icons when using a PS5 Controller
 
PERFORMANCE
Improved performance/framerate with cockpit view in many levels

notes.title: The huge new MechWarrior game finally has a release date
notes.notes:
MechWarrior 5: Clans is the latest entry in the long-running series of large-scale robot shooters that began all the way back in 1989 with a pen-and-paper classic. The Clans, one of the factions taking part in a never-ending galactic war, hasn't been seen since 1995's MechWarriors 2, but now they're back in a co-op squad shooter that serves as an entry point into the series.
Read the rest of the story...
RELATED LINKS:

After three decades, new MechWarrior game goes back to the roots

After Armored Core 6, rival MechWarrior returns with new game

notes.title: MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS RELEASE DATE TRAILER!
notes.notes:
WATCH THE MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS RELEASE DATE TRAILER NOW!

[previewyoutube=cuORqjXoRhE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]




Today Piranha Games Inc. is excited to announce our release date for MechWarrior 5: CLANS! 

The Invasion Begins October 3rd, 2024! 

MechWarrior 5: CLANS is the Standalone Game coming to XBOX Series S - X, PlayStation 5, and PC.

- Experience the Clan Invasion from the perspective of Clan Smoke Jaguar as you lead your Star through engaging missions and combat, with cinematics unlike anything seen before in MechWarrior.

- Strategic adaptability is key to victory and more accessible than ever with the new Battle Grid, Command Wheel, and Streamlined Controls.

- Customize your 'Mechs with advanced Clan weapon systems, equipment, and upgrades for mission-specific battles, and advance your pilots with the new pilot progression system.

- Experience MechWarrior like never before with a fully standalone campaign featuring detailed environments and dynamic destruction using the latest Unreal Engine and new Tech Updates.

- Play with up to 4 other players as you protect and lead your Star through complex missions and thrilling combat
